summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine PDMR share transactions under its Employee Share Purchase Plan for July 2026. The filing lists small acquisitions of ordinary shares by several executives (e.g., Juan de Rueda Gamboa, Ana Callol, Jos Antonio Echeverr a) at a price of $106.56650 per share on July 13, 2026, executed on Nasdaq. It also includes a Total Voting Rights announcement. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign is involved; this is a standard regulatory disclosure of insider share purchases and voting capital updates.
